history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration expedite the review and release of the delegation of authority policy framework and put in place a more agile process to update the delegation of authority policy framework in response to changes to the wider policy framework.
history.administration_response: The revision of ST/SGB/2019/2/Rev.1 is in its finalization stage. The Administration has developed an enhanced version of the delegation of authority portal, which has been tested and is ready to be rolled out. It will be launched with the issuance of the revised delegation instrument once the ST/SGB/2019/2/Rev.1 is published. The enhanced portal will be instrumental in ensuring a more agile process for future updates. Consequently, this recommendation will be implemented once the new revised delegation of authority policy is issued.
history.board_assessment: Given that the revised policy is in its finalization stage, but has not been issued formally, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
